notes:
No turn starts in this fragment: it is one continuous stretch of a single speech that begins before the stretch and runs past its end. The markup carries no bold run at all - this file uses lowercase '

' and '' wrappers, a different WordPerfect export style from the 2002 files, and every paragraph is followed by an EMPTY '' pair that contains no text and means nothing. I checked the wider file (data/raw/senado/taquigraficas/2003-05-07_r07_ESPECIAL.html): the last label before the fragment is 'Sra.\r\nNegre de Alonso. --' (note the line break inside the bold run), and no label falls inside the fragment. The main judgement call: this passage is a dense, footnote-like argument about the 1853 Constitution, quoting Alberdi, Bidart Campos, Sampay, Sagüés, Nino, Belluscio and article 19 verbatim, and it reads like a written paper. I considered whether it is an inserted document with no speaker (rule 3) and decided it is NOT: the earlier part of the same speech, just before the fragment, says 'hoy quiero centrar este homenaje en ese aspecto' and 'a través de las pocas y puntuales palabras que expresaré voy a tomar el pensamiento de...', which is first-person floor delivery in a commemorative sitting, not a document handed in for the record. So it is the continuation of the senator's own turn, and the stretch simply contains no start.
